name: Gate 5B-4 Keyboard Ownership + Sort Viewport Fix
changes: When keyboard input originates inside the ERP Excel-like filter popup, RevoGrid keyboard proxies are cancelled while the original browser KeyboardEvent is left untouched so typing stays inside the filter.
Sort preserves the same logical selected Work Order only while that cell remains inside the current viewport.
If Sort moves the selected Work Order outside the current viewport, cell focus is cleared and the sheet does not scroll after it.
Filter keeps its previously approved behavior: if the selected Work Order remains in the filtered result, selection is restored; if it is filtered out, selection is cleared.
No RevoGrid Community source file is modified.
verification: JavaScript syntax check passed for all modified modules.
Internal behavior checks passed 6/6 for popup keyboard ownership and visible/off-screen sort selection policy.
Browser lab extended for the new behavior; final runtime verification remains on the user's .NET environment.
